title.rendered: Ritz Carlton Half Moon Bay DJ

content.rendered:
Ritz Carlton Half Moon Bay DJ
Mr & Mrs Peter and Sun Tran
American Korean & Vietnamese Wedding DJ MC

 


The Ritz Carlton Half Moon Bay DJ


Ceremony DJ
Wedding (Timeline for Ceremonies)
1. Background
music – suggest vitamin orchestra, piano guys,
2. Seating of
the parents-Officiant – Groomsman March.
3. Wedding Party March-Flower Girl- Ring Bearer – Maid of Honor
4. Processional
: Bride Walks Down the Aisle with her Father “Canon in D
Classical guitar by pachelbel
Vows 6. Recessional
Bride and Groom – Wedding march – richard wagner
___________________________________________
Reception
DJ – Music – (Timeline for Wedding
Receptions)
1. Cocktail Hour
– Peter’s CD with Chris’ mixed in
2. Arrival of the Wedding Party Grand
Entrance – Announce
–
Mrs.Lilly Ko, Matron of Honor
Mr.John Montorello, Best Man Newlyweds
Applause
Mr & Mrs Peter and Sun Tran
3. Wedding Jazz
Background Type – Dinner Is Served-Dinner Music-
Chris’ songs mixed in Slideshow – play thousand years – christina perri.
4. Toast Best
Man Speech/Toast Matron of Honor
5. 1st Dance –
All Time High –
Everybody Dances
6. Cake Cutting
– Honey Girl
7. Dance Music
– Dancing
Dance, Ballroom, Pop, Rock/alt, Classic Rock,
(List
dancing music here) electric slide, frozen idina Menzel let
it go,
time
of my life – from dirty dancing
artist pink
def Leppard pour some sugar
on me.Titanic song
because you love me

8. Last Dance
Song of the Night – Bride & Groom Thank There
Guests Departure –
Goodnight Sweetheart. DO
NOT PLAY any songs that may be offensive with foul language etc.


Asian American


Korean Wedding Disc Jockey


Ritz Carlton Half Moon Bay Ceremony Gifts to Parents


DJ Dancing and our Led Uplighting


Korean Pop KPOP Dancing fun.

`
